attempts.issue: Source backup succeeded; fresh target binary extraction attempted ASCII-8BIT to UTF-8 conversion. World-writable non-sticky parent then masked the exception during secure cleanup.

attempts.resolution: Keep the original 10/s, 30s, in-flight 8, zero-errors/zero-drops gates. Repeat in the final full Ubuntu exercise; no claim of machine-independent production capacity. Exact cause of this isolated client scheduling/concurrency saturation was not established by the stored end-of-run resource sample.
